text_blocks.snippet: Nasal sprays can be used as a preventative measure or treatment for COVID-19. Some commercially available nasal sprays include:

list.snippet: Xlear Nasal Spray: Contains xylitol, which may help reduce viral load in the nose.
I-Clear Nasal Spray: Contains povidone-iodine, an antiseptic that may kill the virus.
Fluticasone-Salmeterol Nasal Spray: A corticosteroid that can reduce inflammation and mucus production.
Budesonide Nasal Spray: Similar to fluticasone-salmeterol, it reduces inflammation.
